units: <cite ref="Taanit 20b:9">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא צָעַדְתִּי בפני מי וכ׳</he> I never walked in front of one my superior; <cite ref="Megillah 28a:21">Meg. 28ᵃ</cite>.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 346:6">Yalk. Ex. 346</cite> <he>הצועד</he>, v. <cite ref="R00215"><he>צוֹעֵר</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Berakhot 29b:17">Ber. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>שתוליכני לשלום ותַצְעִידֵנִי וכ׳</he> that thou mayest lead me in safety and direct me in safety.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 39">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXIX</cite> <he>והיו … מְצַעֲדוֹת על וכ׳</he> and the Egyptian girls used to climb up the walls and throw to him (Joseph) rings &c.
